name: NEON
summary: NEON searches for coherent elastic reactor-antineutrino scattering using high-light-yield sodium-iodide crystals near the Hanbit reactor in South Korea. Its low-threshold datasets also support searches for reactor-produced dark-sector particles.
detection_principle: NaI(Tl) crystal scintillation is read by photomultiplier tubes and surrounded by a liquid-scintillator veto. Low-energy event selection and reactor-on/off comparisons seek a recoil excess over radioactive and instrumental backgrounds.
